**The best Vienna‑based Steuerberater for a French pensioner, Austrian tax resident, former EPO employee with PPI‑based tax exemptions are firms with proven expertise in international individual taxation and immunities/privileges.** Based on current authoritative sources, the strongest match is Rabl Steuerberatung (Vienna), which explicitly handles expatriate taxation and international‑organization‑type cases.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

🎯 Why Vienna is the right place to look Vienna hosts major international organizations (UN, OSCE, OPEC, ESA, EU agencies), and therefore has a small but highly specialized cluster of tax advisors familiar with:

-   Privileges & immunities regimes (similar in structure to the EPO Protocol on Privileges and Immunities)
-   Cross‑border taxation for expatriates and foreign pensioners
-   Double‑tax treaty interactions (France–Austria)
-   Private individuals with mixed pension sources

This niche is not widely mastered in Villach, but Vienna has several firms with the right expertise.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
